name: Gremlin Nob
passives: Enrage: Gains +2 (+3 on A18+) Strength whenever you play a Skill card.
turnPattern: Turn 1: Bellow (Enrage buff). Turn 2: Skull Bash (8 dmg + 2 Vulnerable). Turn 3+: Rush (14-16 dmg, boosted by accumulated Strength).
tips: DO NOT play defensive skills on turns 1-2 unless lethal is prevented. Draft aggressive frontloaded attacks early in Act 1 specifically to race him down.

name: Lagavulin
passives: Asleep: Starts with 8 Metallicize and stays asleep for 3 turns until attacked.
turnPattern: Turn 1-3: Sleep (wakes immediately upon being damaged). Turn 4: Stunned/Waking. Turn 5-6: Heavy Attack (18-20 dmg). Turn 7: Siphon Soul (-1 Str, -1 Dex).
tips: Do not rush waking it on turn 1. Use the 3 sleep turns to play powers, line up scaling, and wait for a heavy attack burst hand.

name: 3 Sentries
passives: Dazed Cycle: Center sentry casts 2 (3 on A18+) Dazed on Turn 1; outer sentries attack for 9 (10). Roles invert each turn.
turnPattern: Odd turns: Outer attack (9x2), Center dazes. Even turns: Outer daze, Center attacks (9).
tips: Focus fire and burst down one of the outer sentries on turn 1-2. Eliminating one immediately cuts incoming pressure by 50%.

name: The Guardian
passives: Defensive Mode: Shifts forms every time he takes 30-40 damage, immediately gaining 20 Block and Sharp Spikes (3-4 thorns on hit).
turnPattern: Offensive: Charges fierce smashes (32-36 dmg). Defensive: Whirlwind multi-hits, rolls into spiked ball, then resets threshold.
tips: Track your damage carefully. Trigger the defensive shift before his charged heavy hit, but avoid multi-hit attacks while Sharp Spikes is active.

name: Hexaghost
passives: Divider: Turn 2 attack hits 6 times; total damage equals (Current Player HP / 12) + 1 per hit.
turnPattern: Turn 1: Activates seals. Turn 2: Divider (6 hits scaling with your health!). Turns 3+: Inferno & Burns, ramping strength.
tips: Entering this fight with lower HP actually reduces Divider damage. Stack heavy block or Weak for Turn 2, then burst him down before the second Inferno cycle.

name: Slime Boss
passives: Split: Cancels current action and splits into two Medium Slimes when HP drops below 50% (70-75 HP).
turnPattern: Turn 1: Goop Spray (3 Slimed). Turn 2: Preparing Slam. Turn 3: Slam (35-38 dmg!). Splits immediately if brought below 50% HP.
tips: Carefully chip him down close to 75 HP, then land your biggest attack to trigger the split with the lowest possible residual health on the spawns.

name: Book of Stabbing
passives: Painful Stabs: Shuffles Wounds into discard pile on hit. Multi-attack count increases by +1 each attack (2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5...).
turnPattern: Alternates between Single Heavy Stab and Multi-Stab (which scales attacks up rapidly every turn).
tips: Requires immediate offensive burst. Disarm, Weak, and Bronze Scales shine here. You cannot out-stall this fight.

name: Gremlin Leader
passives: Gremlin Minions: Commands minions with Encourage (+Str), Rally (+Block & summon), or attacks for 6x3.
turnPattern: If minions are dead, high chance to Summon. If minions are alive, high chance to Encourage or Stab.
tips: Keep the minion count low to force the Leader to waste turns summoning minions rather than buffing or attacking for heavy damage.

name: Taskmaster & Slavers
passives: Entangle (Red Slaver): Net inflicts Entangled, preventing you from playing Attack cards for 1 turn.
turnPattern: Turn 1: Red applies Vulnerable, Taskmaster scours Wounds. Turn 2: Red nets (Entangle).
tips: Kill the Red Slaver on turns 1-2 to prevent Entangle, then eliminate Taskmaster before Wounds flood your deck.

name: The Champ
passives: Phase 2 Enrage: At 50% HP (210-220 HP), cleanses all debuffs, gains +Strength, and executes heavy Execute attack (10x2 -> 14x3).
turnPattern: Phase 1: Taunt, Defensive Stance (Metallicize), Heavy Slash. Phase 2: Anger cleanse followed by devastating Execute.
tips: Do not trigger his 50% threshold prematurely. Accumulate scaling (Strength/Poison/Powers), wait for a clean opening, then burst through the remaining 50%.

name: Bronze Automaton
passives: Hyperbeam: Turn 6 fires Hyperbeam for 45-52 damage, then stuns himself for 1 turn.
turnPattern: Turn 1: Spawn 2 Bronze Orbs (steal your cards). Turn 2-5: Flail & Boost. Turn 6: Hyperbeam.
tips: Save intangible, heavy block, or an Artifact/Buffer potion for Hyperbeam. Destroy the Bronze Orbs quickly to recover stolen key cards.

name: The Collector
passives: Mega Debuff: On turn 4 or 5, casts Mega Debuff applying 3 Vulnerable, 3 Frail, and 3 Weak.
turnPattern: Turn 1: Summons 2 Torch Heads. Turn 2-3: Buffs minions or attacks. Turn 4: Mega Debuff (3 Vuln/Frail/Weak).
tips: Use AoE damage to clear Torch Heads so Collector spends turns resummoning them rather than buffing strength.

name: Giant Head
passives: Slow: Each card played increases all damage dealt to him by 10% this turn. Turn 5+: Enters It Is Time (30-40+ dmg).
turnPattern: Turns 1-4: Count 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 (dealing minor glare debuffs). Turn 5+: Heavy smashes increasing by 5 damage each round.
tips: Play zero-cost skills and draws first to pump the Slow debuff to +50% or +80% before firing your big attacks.

name: Nemesis
passives: Intangible: On alternating turns, gains Intangible (takes only 1 damage from all sources).
turnPattern: Alternates: Intangible turn -> Vulnerable turn -> Intangible turn. Attacks for 6x3 or Scythe (45 dmg) + Burns.
tips: Spend intangible turns cycling cards, applying block, and playing powers. Unleash full damage only when intangible drops.

name: Reptomancer
passives: Dagger Swarm: Continuously summons exploding daggers that charge and suicide-strike for 25 damage each.
turnPattern: Turn 1: Summons 2 Daggers. Turn 2: Snake Strike (13x2 dmg) + summons more daggers. Turn 3: Daggers detonate for 25 each.
tips: Kill the summoned daggers immediately every turn before they detonate. Frontloaded AoE or targeted high damage is required.

name: Time Eater
passives: Time Warp: Playing 12 cards immediately ends your turn and permanently grants him +2 Strength. Cleanses at 50% HP.
turnPattern: Attacks for multi-hits, inflicts Slimed/Vulnerable, and heals to 50% once dropped under half HP.
tips: Count every card played. End your turn intentionally on card 11 rather than having card 12 force an awkward stop with unspent energy.

name: Awakened One
passives: Curiosity: Gains +1 (+2 on A19+) Strength every time you play a Power card in Phase 1.
turnPattern: Phase 1: Slash (20 dmg) accompanied by 2 Cultists. Phase 2: Revives with full HP and unleashes Dark Echo (40 dmg AoE).
tips: Only play game-winning scaling powers in Phase 1. Kill the Cultists immediately on turns 1-2 before their ritual strength spirals.

name: Donu & Deca
passives: Tag Team: Donu gives +3 Strength to both enemies; Deca grants Block and shuffles Dazed cards into your draw pile.
turnPattern: Donu buffs on odd turns, attacks on even turns. Deca attacks on odd turns, shields on even turns.
tips: Kill Donu FIRST! Donu's permanent strength scaling turns them into lethal juggernauts if left alive too long.
